== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Expand The Empire (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1250_14</code>, Virtual Block 5 slip 18), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-18-Expand_The_Empire.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-expandtheempire-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Expand The Empire (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Senate. May raise your converted Senate to the top. Jedi here are politics +4. While your total politics here is > 5, at battlegrounds where you have an Imperial, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. Your aliens (except Mara), senators, Maul, and [Independent Starship] starships are lost. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1005_L6290</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_215</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number, Virtual Block 5 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
